summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Inceptions
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters 213–232 on lunar separation and application, lawsuits, absent persons, stolen goods, hidden money, inceptions, residence changes, sedition, nativities, trigonal signs, military expeditions, annual inspections, and time division. Cross-references cite Deucalion, Valens, Rhetorius, and Parisinus codex 2506.
